description: This file contains unit tests for the ProgressiveEMICalculator class, which is responsible for calculating Equated Monthly Installments (EMI) and related interest schedule models for loans. It includes setup for mock data, various test cases for different interest rate changes, disbursal scenarios, partial payments, and performance testing. The tests validate the correctness of interest calculations, repayment scheduling, and handling of disbursed amounts, interest rate changes, and balance corrections.

classes.name: ProgressiveEMICalculatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ProgressiveEMICalculator's functionality including interest calculations, schedule generation, interest rate changes, partial payments, and performance validation.
